text: Classified AC1, AC2 and AC7 as checkable: no rather than partially, and split AC10 and AC9 out as the mechanically enforceable halves. CLAUDE.md requires a new partially-checkable criterion to be closed in the same changeset; I wrote three and closed none. An honest 'no' with the checkable part extracted is better than a 'partially' that is a permanent tax on attention dressed as coverage
